column1: # #4960 — the 46 ADR/DEC rules from Borg Queen's decomposition (2026-11-12), one per line.

column4: rule
A capability must have one code path; cards introducing a replacement path must delete or delegate the old path in the same commit.
Every governed fact class has one declared write home; generated projections carry `GENERATED — DO NOT EDIT` headers and fail on hand-edits.

Services and roles must authenticate exclusively via CSS Solid-OIDC asymmetric tokens and `chorus:Principal` rows in `urn:chorus:domains:security`; custom passkeys, custom token signers, and sudoers auth workarounds are forbidden.
Internal daemons (Fuseki, Loki, Prometheus, domain APIs) must bind `127.0.0.1` in LaunchAgent plists and service configs, never `0.0.0.0`; external traffic enters only via Caddy TLS / Tailscale.
Runtime services must run as native macOS `launchd` LaunchAgents; Dockerfiles, `docker-compose.yml`, and raw `kill`/`pkill` process management are forbidden.
Compiled daemon deploys must execute the single `ensure-deps → build → install → kickstart` pipeline and prove `runningCdhash == builtCdhash`.

Binaries in the cdhash trust path (`chorus-hooks`, `chorus-inject`, domain doors, `werk` CLI) must be Rust; web UIs and general HTTP integrations use TypeScript; new Python/Go/shell daemons (>50 LOC shell logic) are forbidden.
Harvesters, enrichers, and web apps must exchange data only through Fuseki graphs / domain APIs — never by importing another tier's internal modules or sharing SQLite/temp files.

Vendor-specific CLI/session mechanics (`claude`, `agy`, `codex`, `osascript`) must live inside thin harness adapters; core services and domain crates must not import harness-specific paths or env vars.

Every file under the four value-stream roots (`directing/`, `designing/`, `building/`, `proving/`) must live under `{products,domains,services,skills}/<name>/` (pending C1 reconciliation for `athena-gen`).
Every MCP tool and CLI verb must follow `<product>-<resource>-<verb>`, run with zero runtime package installs, and share one pure Rust function with its `--atomic` sibling.

Generator boundaries are strict: `chorus-make` generates value-stream/step runners; `athena-gen` (`athena-make` v2) generates domain APIs (`--domain <name>`); `loom-make` generates product APIs (`--product <name>`). None may cross into another's unit.
Pipeline YAML under `dagu` must be generated from `chorus-make` / graph definitions, never hand-authored or duplicated in `.github/workflows/`.
Each `chorus-hooks` module enforces one concern; embedding unrelated policy checks inside an existing hook file is forbidden.
Every LaunchAgent plist and listening port must have a matching `Service` / `Port` row in the `infra` domain graph.

`urn:chorus:ontology` must contain only `owl:Class`, property, and `sh:NodeShape` declarations (zero domain instances); every instance must reside in `urn:chorus:domains:<domain>`, with Fuseki `unionDefaultGraph` disabled.

Entity IRIs must use only `chorus:` or `jb:` `https://` namespaces (`borg:` and `gathering:` entity prefixes forbidden); minted IRIs follow `{ns}{type}-{slug}` with max 4 taxonomy levels via `hasChild` (no separate sub-product or sub-domain classes).
Every `chorus:Domain` must be declared as both `a owl:Class` and `a chorus:Domain` with `rdfs:subClassOf` pointing to its `chorus:Product`.
Every `Property.key` used on an instance must match a registered `chorus:PropertyKey` row declaring `appliesTo`, `valueType`, and `cardinality`.
Removing or narrowing an `owl:Class`, predicate, or `sh:NodeShape` requires a MAJOR bump in the ontology version header and migration of active domain graphs in the same card.
Operations classes/predicates (`Trace`, `Span`, `Alert`, `ChangeLeadTime`, etc.) must use `chorus:` IRIs and carry `chorus:adoptedFrom` citing the external OTel/DORA/Prometheus spec URI.

Taxonomy-to-domain and role-ownership mappings must be queried from Fuseki/domain APIs, never hardcoded as lookup tables in `.ts`, `.rs`, or `.sh` source; orphan nodes with zero inbound/outbound edges are forbidden.
column5: Source literal scan + SPARQL orphan query

column4: Harvesters write immutable source-attributed facts (`prov:wasDerivedFrom`); AI/LLM enrichments must write to a separate enrichment graph with model + confidence provenance, never overwriting harvested triples.
Multi-graph SPARQL queries must name every target `GRAPH <urn:...>` explicitly and enforce `jb:visibility` (`private`, `household` or `public`) filter bindings.
Fuseki and SQLite state files must sit on local SSD (never `/tmp` or network shares); Gathering bulk media lives on Bedroom `/Volumes/Gathering` with content-addressed SHA-256 blobs.
UI views (list, tree, matrix, graph) must project from the same domain API dataset rather than maintaining view-specific stores or duplicate JSON files.
Every gating check, hook, SHACL shape, or validator added or modified must include an automated negative-proof fixture where a known violation is proven to fail the check.
Any change to an API serializer, domain model, or response envelope must run against committed golden response fixtures.
Zero `.js`, `.js.map`, or `.d.ts` files may exist alongside `.ts` sources under any `src/` directory.
Compiler/Clippy/ESLint warning ceilings may only stay flat or decrease; lock-files (`Cargo.lock`, `package-lock.json`) must be committed and passing `--locked` / `npm ci`.
column5: CI build warning count + lockfile diff

column4: Services log structured lines to `stdout`/`stderr` routed via LaunchAgent to `~/Library/Logs/` → Promtail → Loki (`:3102`); writing repo `*.log` files or tailing raw log files is forbidden.
Every emitted spine/event payload must validate against its declared `EmitContract` (`trace_id` W3C `traceparent`, `timestamp`, `source`, and `synthetic: true` on conformance probes).
Monitors emit continuous health observations; alerts fire only on actionable state transitions, and every scheduled sensor must push a dead-man liveness timestamp.
Catch blocks and pipeline stages must never swallow errors (`catch {}` or `let _ =` on fallible I/O without logging/returning); every skipped or failed record increments an observable counter.

column4: Every active `chorus:Domain` must declare at least one executable fitness function checking live runtime reality against graph declarations.
Domain HTTP endpoints must return `{ data, meta: { count, request_id } }` on 2xx and RFC-9457 `application/problem+json` on 4xx/5xx, honoring `Idempotency-Key` on `POST`.
Mutations must check `ownedBy` + `writeScope` against the caller's CSS `Principal`; properties marked `exposure: secret` must never be serialized in HTTP or MCP responses.
Store doors must build SPARQL updates from typed IRI/literal bindings (never raw string interpolation of user input) and enforce `If-Match` ETag preconditions on writes.

Stored timestamps must be UTC ISO-8601 (`Z` / `xsd:dateTime`); human-facing UIs, logs, and agent headers must render `America/New_York` (`Boston`) via the shared helper — never raw `Date.now()` local assumptions.
Automated tests must set `BOARD_DRY_RUN=1` / isolated test graphs and must never create live Vikunja cards, send live `osascript` nudges, or mutate prod Fuseki graphs.
Application and skill code must call typed domain HTTP/MCP endpoints rather than issuing direct HTTP calls to Fuseki `:3030`.
Architectural/multi-service features require a Jeff-reviewed HTML service design doc using the consumer-first plain-English template before implementation cards move to WIP.
New personal data domains and attributes default to `jb:visibility "private"`; exposing data to `household` or `public` routes requires an explicit graduation rule on the card.
Cross-domain cards must attach `borg-read-blast-radius` output and owner acknowledgment before `werk-pull` transitions the card to WIP.
Each role holds at most 1 active `building` card in WIP (smallest-first tiebreaker at equal priority); pulling a second card requires unpulling or completing the first.
User-invocable skills must emit initial status/output within 5 seconds and format routine operational events as single-line compact summaries.
